text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
Kris S! Didn't I tell you to get your wish 
list ready?! It's already the day of!

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
What on earth should I bring to your 
birthday party?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
"That's okay. As long as you come—to the 
party— I am hosting... that will be 
enough."

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
No way, that won't do! Just hand over your 
wish list already! Say it out loud if you 
have to, just tell me what you want!

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
Otherwise, I'm gonna take away 100 of my 
favorite pizzas!!

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
See, you're at a loss, aren't you! That's 
why you gotta tell me what you actually 
want—

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
—You really are... Either completely 
selfless, or just totally pure...

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
Haha, got it! I'll bring along some super 
delicious pizza, so look forward to it!
